findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify, tokenlock_info, start_token_signin, finish_token_signin · Private data: get_quote, create_proof, broadcast, verify, check_name, verify_agent, buy_name, create_challenge, verify_challenge, products, tokenlock_info, check_token_access, start_token_signin, finish_token_signin · Public sink: create_proof, broadcast, get_proof_status, buy_name, get_name_order, create_challenge, finish_token_signin · Destructive: tokenlock_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify, tokenlock_info, start_token_signin, finish_token_signin · Private data: get_quote, create_proof, broadcast, verify, check_name, verify_agent, buy_name, create_challenge, verify_challenge, products, tokenlock_info, check_token_access, start_token_signin, finish_token_signin · Public sink: create_proof, broadcast, get_proof_status, buy_name, get_name_order, create_challenge, finish_token_signin · Destructive: tokenlock_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
